description: 📍Checkmyguest offers you this superb 80 m² apartment, designed to comfortably accommodate up to 8 people. Just a stone's throw from shops and transport, it combines elegance, modernity and practicality for a serene Parisian stay.The space⭐Ideally located on the first floor of a luxury building, this 80 m² apartment combines modernity, refinement and absolute comfort, for an unforgettable stay in Paris. From the moment you enter, you'll be seduced by the quality of the materials, the high-end furnishings and the contemporary ambience carefully thought out to offer everyone a space that's both warm and functional.This location allows you to explore Paris using easily accessible public transport. You'll be able to reach the city's most emblematic sites: Parc Monceau, Eiffel Tower, Louvre Museum, Sacré Coeur, Champs-Elysées, Arc de Triomphe...
